context:
Goal: no two lanes do the same work, and each lane is a fair size (your 13:27 CST ask for deduplication and balanced workloads).
Problem (goal): the coordinator took these undoable picks on Nov 12, 13:36-13:43 CST without asking you; they stand unless you choose b.
Based on (measured): the coordinator's size and duplicate audit of the 44 lanes started today.
Departs from: main has no such picks on record — the lanes they govern follow these picks.
home: the roadmap steps each pick names (record branch)

options.gain: Fewer lanes doing the same work, and smaller changes that review faster.
options.how: Close two lanes whose work already exists: the merge-claim timeout fix (already merged) and the push refusal during a batch run (covered by draft PR #2463). Fold the worktree role pins lane into the lane refusing mixed merges, and the roadmap push hint into the batch merge guard. The batch split-and-pipeline lane keeps running, cut to building the next batch on the running one, at the top of the express list; its split-and-rebuild half moves to the dropped-batch queue lane. The batch freeze lane keeps only the express lane and cancel; the review fix-check lane drops its rule text; the coordinator board ships as three PRs. A fresh lane rebuilds PR #2463 on today's main, first in the next list. Undo: reopen any closed step or restart a stopped lane.
options.label: Keep the picks (Recommended)
options.lose: A stopped lane's partial work waits for its new home.

options.gain: No lane loses work in a hand-over.
options.how: Each lane keeps its scope as started; the coordinator reverses the closes and folds.
options.label: Overrule them
options.lose: Duplicate lanes and large changes stay.

short: Lane audit picks: close, fold, split
title: Lane audit: two closes, two folds, four splits, one fresh rebuild
why: Coordinator picks you could not see before.
